reason: As someone who has quit three services, I trust B more: it says up front that it can't promise my A1C will drop, it admits medication changes weren't tracked, and it deals with getting tired of the food, which is why I quit before. A credits the 0.6-point average drop to the ten who improved, though the brief only gives it as the average, and A leaves out the medication caveat, so it reads more like the sales pitches I've learned to distrust.
